name: Context
description:
Give Claude direct access to current web data through Context.dev. Search the web, turn pages into clean Markdown or HTML, crawl websites, extract schema-shaped JSON, parse PDFs and other files, capture screenshots, and retrieve brand intelligence.

For ongoing or high-volume work, create monitors that surface meaningful changes and run asynchronous batches across up to 25,000 URLs.

Built for research, RAG pipelines, competitive intelligence, enrichment, design workflows, and any task that needs reliable web context without maintaining custom scrapers.

server.name: context
server.title: Context
server.description: Turn the live web, company news, and files into reliable, agent-ready context. Connect with OAuth or a Context API key through the Authorization header, X-API-Key header, or api_key URL parameter.

protocolMetadata.instructions:
Use Context for live web or news, URLs, files, brands, people, batches, and monitoring. Route: `get-news-search` for one company's news; `web-search` for broad research; `web-answers` for researched JSON; `web-scrape` for one page; `web-map` for site URLs; `web-crawl` for linked pages; `submit-batch` for large jobs; `parse-document` for file bytes. Prefer compact search and scrape results. Browser actions affect sites; use only requested actions.

Use `get-brand` for visual domain data, `brand-retrieve-unified` for raw or non-domain data, `brand-search` for matches, `people-enrich` for people, and `web-styleguide` for design systems. Monitors are recurring only; check `get-monitor-limits`. For batches call `get-batch`, then `get-batch-results`. Webhook list/get tools inspect; retry resends and secret rotation replaces the receiver secret.

Only when needed for account failures, use `list-logs`, then `get-log` with its request ID.

Report each distinct unexpected error, docs mismatch, or wrong or incomplete successful data once with `submit-feedback`, even after a workaround. Include category, expected versus actual behavior, a sanitized reproduction, and the affected request_id; otherwise use a relevant public page or docs url. Never invent or use an unrelated ID, or include API keys, tokens, cookies, private content, personal data, or secret URL parameters. Respect user preferences and host permissions. Expected validation, authentication, or credit-limit errors, empty results, and MCP truncation are not automatically bugs. If submission fails, do not retry or report itself; mention the failure. Claim success only after confirmation. Feedback costs no credits.

Auth: OAuth or an API key via `Authorization: Bearer <key>`, `X-API-Key: <key>`, or URL `api_key`. Prefer OAuth or headers; URLs may be logged. Avoid duplicate calls. On `USAGE_EXCEEDED`, do not retry; call `get-usage` once, tell the user the balance and refill, and continue independent work. Use idempotency

tool.title: Scrape a URL
tool.description: Scrape one known URL and return any combination of HTML, Markdown, a screenshot, page images, original bytes, CSS-selected fields, relevant highlights, schema-shaped JSON, or product data. Supports browser actions, custom target headers, PDF parsing, deadlines, and zero data retention. Browser clicks can change the target site's state. Prefer responseMode="compact" with formats.highlights and highlightsParams.query for focused research; use full for complete content or metadata. Use web-search when the URL is unknown, web-map for URLs only, web-crawl for linked pages, or submit-batch for large asynchronous jobs.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Context to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.context.dev/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Context MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Context scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Context's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 14, 2026, Context scores 80/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 42 of 42 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Context MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Context lists 35 MCP tools, including brand-retrieve-unified, cancel-batch, create-monitor, delete-batch, delete-monitor, get-batch, get-batch-results, get-brand, get-change, get-monitor, get-monitor-run, and list-account-runs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Context?
